blurb: Maui Sights & Treasures offers a variety of ocean, land, and air activities including snorkeling, dinner cruises, day tours, and helicopter tours. They provide local expertise and value for money with over 40 years of experience. Tours include Molokini Snorkel and Sail, Dinner Sunset Maui Cruise, Day Tour to Lana’i, and Half Day Helicopter and Van Tour to Hana.

quotes.author: Vani
quotes.text: Mahalo for the discount and arranging our excursion. Most of my gang of friends had never been on a whale watching trip before and I’ve turned every one of them into whale fanatics. . I recommended you and them to several people who were interested in going whale watching. We came back to snow in Seattle and are ready to turn around and come back to paradise. We hope to return next year and this time we will stop by the shop and of course use you for another whale watching trip which is my favorite thing in the world to do.

quotes.author: Jean and Cody Logit
quotes.text: Thank-you to Luann at Maui Sights & Treasures for helping to make our first time to Maui the perfect Vacation. She was so helpful and worked so hard to get the days and activity times we needed. Our honeymoon was filled with snorkeling,fishing,and a Luau. They were all so much FUN. Thank-You so much

quotes.author: Melinda and John Woosley
quotes.text: Mary, LuAnn and Athena, Thanks for the excellent service. Looking forward to our massage and sunset cruise. Will recommend your company to others! Your prices were lower than the other companies we have booked with in the past. The response to e-mails was quick. Mahalo, Melinda and John Woosley
